newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Lujiazui to list 60 mln more B shares.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Lujiazui to list 60 mln more B shares.

text.p: Shanghai Lujiazui Finance and Trade Zone Development Co Ltd will list 60 million additional foreign currency B shares on Thursday on the Shanghai stock exchange, a company statement said on Monday.

The shares were sold at 5.50 yuan per share in a rights issue earlier this month and the proceeds will be used to develop real estate projects in the Lujiazui district of the Pudong development zone in eastern Shanghai, the statement said.
Lujiazui currently has 200 million B shares listed on the Shanghai exchange.
After the rights issue, the company has a total of 952.9 million outstanding shares.
B shares account for 27.3 percent of the company's total outstanding shares, with domestic A shares comprising 81.9 million shares, or 8.59 percent.
The state owns 572 million shares, or 60.02 percent, and institutions 39 million shares, or 4.09 percent.
